goal: Close FAE-DP6 FPGA timing at AWS F2 250 MHz using the smallest evidence-justified HLS intervention while preserving exact DP6 semantics and validated AWS HLx/HBM integration.
invariants: FAE-DP6 output semantics remain byte-for-byte identical.
Frozen FAE-DP6 consensus source SHA256 fd9ecbb67b2d679ddb9737ec98c8073fede1d0d7dd5b0c1d19b7b4d02265ae78 is not modified by this run.
The HLS implementation is an implementation artifact and never consensus authority.
Canonical full-160-byte parity and independent 16-vector parity are required before physical implementation.
Validated AWS HLx shell and HBM topology remain unchanged unless independent evidence proves a topology defect.
A Developer_CL.tar produced with negative WNS is inadmissible.
The physical timing gate requires WNS >= 0, TNS = 0, WHS >= 0, and THS = 0.
Frozen HFB thresholds and measurement definitions do not change during timing hardening.
AWS paid spend remains capped at USD 20 out-of-pocket with credits used first.
No wallet key, seed, testnet consensus, mainnet, monetary-policy, or release authority is granted by this run.
forbidden_actions: change the FAE-DP6 algorithm or consensus parameters
weaken or bypass the WNS/TNS/WHS/THS timing gate
promote a failed-timing Developer_CL.tar to AFI
change AWS shell or HBM topology merely to conceal an HLS timing defect
handle wallet seed phrases or private keys
exceed the authorized USD 20 out-of-pocket AWS cap
treat a builder self-report as verification

domains.objective: Reproduce and classify the failing FAE-DP6 setup paths across the baseline and both valid P&R variants, identifying stable hotspot families without modifying source.

gates.description: Cross-run timing-path attribution backed by routed timing reports.

domains.objective: Map timing-hardening transformations by semantic risk and identify the smallest HLS-only interventions that cannot intentionally alter DP6 calculations, addresses, or state-transition order.

gates.description: Source-linked semantic risk map and bounded candidate set.

domains.objective: Freeze the fail-closed evidence ladder for each timing-hardening candidate from source diff through parity, HLS synthesis, physical timing, tarball admission, and AFI eligibility.

gates.description: Fail-closed verification ladder with immutable admission thresholds.

domains.objective: Select the smallest first HLS intervention justified jointly by physical path attribution, source semantics, and verification coverage; define explicit fallback and rejection conditions.

gates.description: Evidence-bound first intervention and ordered fallback ladder.

domains.objective: Implement only the selected localized HLS intervention on the isolated timing-hardening branch, without changing DP6 semantics or AWS HLx/HBM integration.

gates.description: Bounded HLS-only source diff matching the selected intervention.

domains.objective: Independently verify canonical full-160-byte parity and 16-vector parity for the patched HLS source before any paid physical build.

gates.description: Canonical 160-byte PASS plus independent 16/16 vector PASS.

domains.objective: Run Vitis HLS CSIM, csynth, resource/tractability checks, and IP export for the parity-clean candidate.

gates.description: CSIM and csynth PASS with acceptable resource/tractability evidence and exported IP.

domains.objective: Integrate the exported candidate IP into the unchanged validated AWS HLx/HBM topology and run full physical implementation at 250 MHz.

gates.description: Final routed WNS >= 0, TNS = 0, WHS >= 0, THS = 0 with unchanged HLx/HBM topology.

domains.objective: Admit a Developer_CL.tar for AFI creation only if all prior gates pass; record immutable tarball digest and leave runtime benchmarking downstream.

gates.description: Timing-clean Developer_CL.tar with recorded SHA-256 and no failed upstream gate.
